_meta.purpose: Ground-truth reference for classifying which authority owns each tolled road in India, since no single government API provides this classification directly.
_meta.method: Each entry below was individually verified via web search against Wikipedia/AARoads/MoRTH-sourced articles. Entries NOT marked verified are structural placeholders and must not be treated as confirmed.
_meta.known_gap: MoRTH had designated 8 roads as National Expressways as of April 2021. Only 6 are confirmed by name below. NE6 and the 8th are NOT yet identified - do not assume NE6 is any specific road.
_meta.cross_check_finding: Checked all 14 plazas whose NAME contains 'DME' (Delhi-Mumbai Expwy, which should be NE4) in the india_tolls_raw_1674.json community dataset. Result: ZERO were tagged 'NE4'. Their nh_no values were: NH-9 (7 plazas), NH-334 (4 plazas), 'NE II' (1), 'NE 3' (2). The nh_no field appears to record whichever conventional highway number the plaza's coordinate is nearest to, not the expressway it actually serves. CONCLUSION: nh_no cannot be trusted as a road-identity field for expressway plazas in this dataset - the plaza NAME text is a more reliable signal, and even that requires manual confirmation per corridor.

categories.NE: National Expressways - primary corridors, NHAI/Centre, cross state borders, formally NE-tagged
categories.SE: State Expressways - regional corridors, built and owned by state authorities, NOT part of the national expressway system even when operated to similar standards
categories.NHAI_intrastate: Built by NHAI but stay within one state - may not carry an NE tag even though centrally owned
